name: Hoàn Kiếm Lake & Ngọc Sơn
description: A central lake with a red bridge to Ngọc Sơn Temple in Hanoi’s old quarter.

name: One Pillar Pagoda
description: A historic wooden pagoda rising from a square pond on a single pillar.

name: Imperial City
description: Citadel walls enclose the former Nguyễn dynasty imperial enclosure.

name: Mỹ Sơn
description: Cham temple ruins in a valley southwest of Hội An.

name: Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica
description: A red-brick cathedral faces Paris Commune Square in District 1.

name: Hạ Long Bay
description: Limestone karsts rise from emerald water — cruises leave from the bay towns.

name: Hội An Ancient Town
description: Lantern-lit streets and wooden shophouses form a UNESCO trading port.

name: Sa Pa terraces
description: Rice terraces and hill-tribe villages surround a mountain town in Lào Cai.

name: Mekong Delta canals
description: Floating markets and orchards along Mekong branches.

name: Phong Nha caves
description: Cave systems in a UNESCO park including Phong Nha and Paradise caves.

name: Bến Thành Market
description: A landmark market hall for souvenirs, produce and food stalls.

name: Hanoi Old Quarter street food
description: Pho, bun cha and egg coffee fill the 36 streets’ low stools.

name: Chợ Lớn markets
description: Chinatown markets and noodle shops west of District 1.

name: Hội An central market
description: Cao lầu and white rose dumplings sell beside the market hall.

name: Đà Nẵng beach restaurants
description: Seafood kitchens line Mỹ Khê and city riverfronts.

name: Tết (Lunar New Year)
description: Vietnam’s main holiday of family reunions, flowers and temple visits.
